jobs.p1_rush: tall vertical picture: a plain room in the daytime. The main character is caught mid-run in a frantic hurry, leaning forward on its hind legs, front paws full: one paw clutches a phone, the other balances one mug; four small plain square sticky notes flutter in the air around its head; its eyes are wide and busy, mouth open, ears flying back with speed, a few small speed lines behind it. The flame on the tip of its tail burns bright and flickers. In the background on the right stands a small plain desk with one blank sheet of paper and one pencil lying untouched on it, a thin layer of dust on the sheet. LAYOUT: the main character is big and whole, filling most of the height from the floor to the upper third, in the middle left; the sticky notes float in the air around its head, apart from each other; the desk is small on the right; plain wall; the phone screen is blank, the mug and the notes are plain, no letters or numbers anywhere.
jobs.p2_zero: tall vertical picture: evening in a plain room in soft dim light. The main character lies flat on its back on the floor, utterly exhausted, paws spread, eyes half closed and tired, tongue slightly out; all around it on the floor lie many small plain square sticky notes, each crumpled and done. Above it on a plain desk lies one big blank sheet of paper with one pencil beside it, perfectly clean and untouched. The flame on the tip of its tail is a small dim ember with a thin wisp of smoke. LAYOUT: the character is whole and large in the lower half; the desk with the blank sheet is whole in the upper half, the sheet clearly visible; plain wall; no letters, numbers or ticks anywhere.
jobs.p3_quick: tall vertical picture made of two equal panels one above the other with a plain gap between them, the same plain room in both. TOP PANEL: the main character presses one tiny plain sticky note onto the wall and grins with delight, eyes squeezed happily shut, a burst of small sparkles and little stars popping around its head like a reward. BOTTOM PANEL: the same character stands small and hesitant in front of one huge blank sheet of paper that towers over it like a wall, its ears down and one paw raised to its mouth. The flame on its tail is bright in the top panel and dim in the bottom panel. LAYOUT: both panels the same size; the character whole in each panel; plain walls; the paper and the note are blank; no letters or numbers anywhere.
